findings.claim: Corning's FY2025 10-K risk factors state that if its products or technologies become obsolete or disrupted by emerging technologies, revenue and operating margins could be negatively impacted in both near and long term.
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025, Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: if our products or technologies become obsolete or disrupted by emerging technologies, it could negatively impact our revenue and operating margins for both near- and long-term.

findings.claim: Hollow-core fiber is an emerging alternative to solid-glass fiber; early deployments are short-haul, high-value routes; competitors beyond Corning exist.
findings.source: STL, Hollow Core Fiber: The Next Frontier in Ultra-Low-Latency Optical Networks
findings.excerpt: Hollow Core Fiber: The Next Frontier in Ultra-Low-Latency Optical Networks For years, fiber-optic innovation focused on sending more data through glass.

findings.claim: Corning research VP says move from copper to fiber in AI back-end networks is inevitable; CPO is central to this shift (Corning positioned as beneficiary).
findings.source: Fierce Network, Corning wants to cut copper out of the data center
findings.excerpt: copper Plenty of copper wiring lurks in the data center, and Corning sees a ripe opportunity to replace it with optical fibers. (Art by Midjourney for Fierce Network) Corning wants to replace the copper cables in data center servers to optical fiber Data centers use a ton of copper for various purposes, which is poised to push their power constraints to the limit Corning said co-packaged optics

findings.claim: Cignal AI expects CPO deployments to start in 2026 with large-scale deployment in three to five years.
findings.source: Lightwave, Co-packaged optics deployments will start in 2026, says Cignal AI
findings.excerpt: Co-packaged optics deployments will start in 2026, says Cignal AI The research firm notes hyperscalers will conduct early deployments. Sean Buckley March 20, 2025

note: Search found hollow-core fiber and CPO discussed as shifts, but no source analyzing them as a threat to Corning revenue; sources found were summaries without verbatim text read. Hollow-core: Microsoft collaboration with Corning to produce it (Sep 2025 per market report); competitors Lightera, Furukawa, Heraeus Covantis; Google focused on multi-core fiber. CPO: Cignal AI expects large-scale deployment in 3-5 years. 線索 3 條，程式核實 3 條
